deniedGlobals.Date: Date reads the host clock and time zone: simulation time is the tick (ADR 0003).
deniedGlobals.Intl: Intl depends on the host's locale data (ADR 0003).
deniedGlobals.globalThis: globalThis reaches host globals that no rule here can see (ADR 0003 P5).
deniedGlobals.WeakRef: WeakRef observes garbage collection, which differs between runs (ADR 0003).
deniedGlobals.FinalizationRegistry: FinalizationRegistry observes garbage collection, which differs between runs (ADR 0003).
deniedGlobals.SharedArrayBuffer: SharedArrayBuffer shares memory between threads; the engine is single-threaded (ADR 0003).
deniedGlobals.Atomics: Atomics serves shared-memory threads; the engine is single-threaded (ADR 0003).
deniedGlobals.Promise: The engine is synchronous: asynchronous work belongs to the host (ADR 0003, plan §I.1).
deniedGlobals.Proxy: A Proxy runs code on every property access, so a value behind one can answer differently on each read: engine values are plain data (ADR 0020, ownership).
deniedGlobals.Set: Set iterates in insertion order, which a resumed world may not share: iterate records in canonical order (plan §I.1).
deniedGlobals.WeakMap: WeakMap keeps state outside the canonical, hashed world (plan §I.1).
deniedGlobals.WeakSet: WeakSet keeps state outside the canonical, hashed world (plan §I.1).
deniedGlobals.Function: Function compiles strings into code at run time, like eval (ADR 0003 P5).
deniedGlobals.Bun: Bun is a host API: the engine core is runtime-agnostic (ADR 0003 P5).
deniedGlobals.crypto: crypto is a host API and an unseeded random source (ADR 0003).
deniedGlobals.structuredClone: structuredClone is a host API, not ECMAScript (ADR 0003 P5).
deniedGlobals.Reflect: Reflect.ownKeys enumerates keys in insertion order, which a resumed world may not share: iterate records in canonical order (plan §I.1).

patterns.message: `bun` and `bun:*` are host APIs: the engine core is runtime-agnostic (ADR 0003 P5).
`node:*` modules are host APIs: the engine core is runtime-agnostic (ADR 0003 P5).
The engine depends on nothing: import only relative paths inside packages/engine/src (docs/architecture/overview.md).
`bun` and `bun:*` are host APIs: packages/agents is runtime-agnostic, like the engine core (ADR 0003 P5).
`node:*` modules are host APIs: packages/agents is runtime-agnostic, like the engine core (ADR 0003 P5).
packages/agents imports only relative paths inside packages/agents/src and the engine's public entry `@open-origin/engine`, never a path inside it (ADR 0023).
